060e3314734e8774569db473b0b7bcde28a110e4.summary: Cado Security's January 2022 blog post links the Abcbot botnet to Xanthe, a cryptojacking malware family that Cisco Talos reported in late 2020. The report cites shared infrastructure, identical code and function names, reused user-agent strings and backdoor usernames, and it believes one threat actor is behind both. It suggests the actor has moved from mining Monero toward botnet activity such as DDoS attacks, and it notes that the Abcbot sample lacks the mining and Docker-targeting features of Xanthe.
